ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions spanning 85% of both lobes; a central low-intensity vertical wedge at the peduncle junction featuring horizontal high-intensity striations (ladder pattern); dark low-intensity border (width 2-10 pixels) along the trailing edge; small low-intensity punctate blobs scattered across the medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:3 within the central indentation region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular micro-serrations (frequency ~6-8 peaks per 100 pixels) with pixel amplitudes of 5-15 units along the linear trailing edge boundary; significant irregular pixel massing at the distal fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve originating from the median notch for approximately 70% of the lobe length, transitioning to a convex curve at the distal 30% segment toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-density clusters of dark pixels forming irregular masses at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization; scattered individual low-intensity circular spots on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue growths/masses on both distal fluke tips; jagged loss of material (notching) visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe medial to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct 'ladder-like' horizontal intensity banding within the central low-intensity vertical wedge at the peduncle-fluke junction.
